ledger.reviewer: Codex AI one rater, not independent human

reconciliation.finding_1: Original decoder learned TinyStories next-token distribution better than TRAIN-only bigram; formal VAL H1 PASS.
reconciliation.finding_2: Good average next-token NLL does not entail semantics-preserving multi-token generation, instruction response, or counterfactual completion selection.
reconciliation.finding_3: Older checkpoint 1280 shows a small VAL NLL reduction and some exploratory aggregate-quality change, but adherence does not improve; data/format/rating confounds remain.
reconciliation.finding_4: FRESH12 uses independent-from-executor AI scoring but only one AI rater; strong observed low adherence level and no serialization treatment benefit under registered candidate gates.
reconciliation.finding_5: CF1 one-shot observes 0/36 correct both-context pairs and 0/36 preference flips, with weak mean context effect relative to completion prior. The exercise itself has shallow heuristic and A=x/B=y position confound. No global neural incapacity proven.
reconciliation.finding_6: FRESH16 is prereg source-ready only: no outputs or scientific verdict; don't reuse its unspent prompts as already-scored evidence.
reconciliation.finding_7: Q1Q2 original attempts are consumed and partial, not a valid full quality/speed comparator; historical T4 TEST and Q1Q2 not reopened.
reconciliation.finding_8: Don't attribute semantic weaknesses uniquely to data scarcity, CE objective, capacity or attention; each remains hypothesis needing equal-budget intervention.

causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Trailing whitespace materially changes initial token, but this did not solve semantic adherence on FRESH12
Train 2048 stories, context-bound windows, repeats 8.42x and limited coverage may underrepresent conditioning tasks
Uniform next-token CE contains no explicit task/goal-state supervision; conditional completion objective weighting might matter
3.75M params, BPE2048 and context256 might limit generalization; no matched-data matched-budget scale arm
No evidence that O1 improves performance under same data budget, metrics and checkpoint

methodological_non_comparability: T4 VAL/TEST NLL scores all next-tokens, not conditional alignment with a specified story premise
FRESH12 rubric values are one AI rater on greedy generations, not same metric, holdout population or design as CF1
CF1 compares two teacher-forced candidates (log probabilities) with per-pair exact sign thresholds, not free-form generation quality
1280 continuation comes from a different already-consumed exploratory run, not an untreated same-budget data/objective arm
FRESH16 source QA and AC preflight are not neural outcomes
Q1Q2 partial native outputs cannot be extrapolated to full 74 request experiment
Historical TEST values may be cited from reports but TEST source must not be opened or scored again
